spec_match.rationale: The two comma rules (size OR style() branch) are valid spec usage, and the firing readouts now observe the cascade — getComputedStyle flex-direction on the card inner and display on the full description — so what the page reports is the engine's applied result, verified matching the any-clause semantics on Chromium 153.

interactive.rationale: Two real toggles set the custom properties, the container is drag-resizable, and a new labelled width slider drives the width branch on keyboard/touch; all controls driven headless through 640/400/300px plus both flags.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a product card switching on width OR a custom-property flag with toggles — matching the page.

edge_cases.rationale: A requires-Chrome-150 support note appears whenever the rendered card disagrees with the clause arithmetic (hidden on this supporting build, verified), and the rule labels name which branch produced each match, including the both-branches case.

conformance.rationale: The shared feature suite runs 4 pass / 1 fail on Chromium 153; the four real parse/CSSOM contracts pass (the fifth is flagged for a human on the breakpoint-matrix critique).

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session, so per auto-research.md §0 this is NOT MCP browser verification — but every control was driven via headless Chromium 153 (Playwright/CDP over the real Chrome binary): width sweeps 640→400→300px, both flag toggles, branch labels, support-note visibility; zero console errors and failed requests; screenshots read at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3; re-run fresh after the final edit.

telemetry_health.rationale: The page asserts `or-cond-engine-matches-expected` (observed card state vs clause arithmetic) on every change, so the readout-vs-render mismatch class of bug now surfaces in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; card-btn.primary and toggle-btn.active set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Both force-flag toggles expose aria-pressed (verified flipping), the rules-active panel is a polite live region announcing rule transitions, and the new width slider is a labelled native range input.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: no horizontal page overflow (the card grows inside its own overflow-x scroller), and the width branch is genuinely reachable on mobile via the slider — all states driven on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Decorative Add-to-cart/Wishlist buttons are focusable no-ops
openQuestions.detail: The product card's Add-to-cart and Wishlist buttons exist only to make the card believable but are real focusable buttons that do nothing when activated. Mark them aria-hidden + tabindex=-1 (or inert on their row) so keyboard users do not land on dead controls.

summary: Repaired 2026-10-25 (weekly hardening): rule state is now read from the rendered card — getComputedStyle flex-direction for the layout rule and the full description's display for the description rule — with clause arithmetic kept only as the expected state, branch labels naming width/style()/both, a requires-Chrome-150 note on disagreement, and a telemetry assert pinning agreement. Added aria-pressed to both toggles, made the rules panel a live region, and added a width slider (in an overflow scroller so wide states are reachable at 360px). Verified on headless Chromium 153 (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): readouts agreed with the rendered card at 640/400/300px and under both flags on desktop and mobile, clean console/network, fresh reload after the final edit.

guidanceConsulted.query: container query style() custom property rule match detection getComputedStyle
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Read applied component state back from the rendered styles the conditional rules set, rather than re-deriving conditions in script.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: rule firing is observed via getComputedStyle(.card-inner).flexDirection and getComputedStyle(.card-desc-full).display after a double rAF.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chromium 153: readouts matched the rendered card through all width/flag combinations on both viewports.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button aria-pressed live region announce state change
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose toggle state with aria-pressed and announce state changes through a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: both flag toggles flip aria-pressed and the rules-active panel is aria-live=polite.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: aria-pressed verified flipping in the headless run; panel text updates on every transition.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible labeling and keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a native labelled range input for continuous values so keyboard and touch get native behaviour.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the width slider is a native <input type=range> with a visible <label for>, two-way synced with the drag handle via ResizeObserver.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Slider drove both width thresholds headless at 360px viewport inside the scroller.
